title: Burning Desire to Distain & Back
subtitle: A first, messier look at Neo-Expressionism — learning by feel.
seo_title: Burning Desire to Distain — Neo-Expressionism Generative Art
seo_description: A neo-expressionist generative art collection exploring raw emotion, distorted figures, and visceral abstraction.
thumb_alt: Neo-expressionist artwork featuring highly textured, emotionally raw, and abstracted forms
img_alt: Detail views of textured brushstrokes in neo-expressionist generative pieces
tiles: Texture, gesture, and honesty about feeling
The pieces I kept for their rawness
challenge: Neo-Expressionism is not a careful movement. It's paint thick on the canvas and feeling close to the surface — and I wasn't sure what working through that on my end would turn up. I wanted to take it seriously as a way of looking at the world, not just a style.
approach: I read into the painters — their histories, what they were reacting to, why the surface of the work matters so much — and then drafted many variations that tried to stay honest to that intensity. I kept the ones that felt like they had something genuine in them rather than a performance of it.
result: A rough, charged little collection that I'm fond of for its honesty. It's available as prints for anyone who appreciates work that doesn't try to be polite.
